scope.summary: w4_describe_view_after_describe_keeps_session_usable no longer replaces the canonical fixture view V_TYPES_${run_id}; it creates and cleans up its own D7_V_SESS view, so source-tools w4_get_ddl_view asserts the unmodified fixture against its existing golden in both scoped and family runs.
out_of_scope: Driver behaviour of applying family before_server setup to scoped runs (not changed; the case no longer mutates canonical fixtures).

entry_points.name: W4 external client, release binary (verifier re-execution)
entry_points.trace: Release binary from a clean export of 12e16ecb. --case w4_describe_view_after_describe_keeps_session_usable alone: pass stdio+http on free23, xe21, xe18. --case w4_get_ddl_view alone on free23: pass stdio+http. Source-tools family (all 40 ids in one invocation) 80/80 on each lane, w4_get_ddl_view passing against tests/golden/w4 files that were not modified in fc6bba0a..12e16ecb (only the issue46 goldens were added in that range).

limitations: A full unscoped lane (all families) ordering was not the proof here; scoped family runs and single-case runs were.
